own_solution.law: Normal-incidence Fresnel reflectance is R=((1.5-1)/(1.5+1))^2=0.04. Adding the incoherent transmitted powers gives Pt=P0(1-R)^2/(1-R^2)=12P0/13.
assumptions: Ordinary nonmagnetic glass and air with lossless interfaces.
All forward-emerging transmitted beams are included.
Increasing the beam source output by q increases incident beam power by q.
The earlier experiment is separate from the stated experiment, whose incident beam power is 50 mW.
The wall-directed lamp does not illuminate the plate in the intended optical model.

T463C.regime: Incident beam power P0 is below damage threshold q; 50 mW is below all listed thresholds.

T146E.regime: Incident beam power P0 is below damage threshold q; 50 mW is below all listed thresholds.

defect_reasons.other: In T60FB and T9EF0, 'before the transmitted power was measured' can suggest the current measurement despite the intended attachment to a separate earlier experiment.

counterexamples: Under the alternative temporal reading that T9EF0 describes an adjustment after establishing the current 50 mW beam and before its measurement, the transmitted power would be 78.4615384615 mW instead of 46.1538461538 mW.
